Title: All Analytics custom logs are now grouped under the schema “Custom Logs” category

Body.Content:
If you’re using custom logs in Azure Log Analytics, you might have noticed that these tables no longer show up under the schema “Log Management” category. Where did they go?

The answer is simple—we’ve created a separate, dedicated category named “Custom Logs,” so you can quickly access these special tables.

Here’s what it looks like now:

Note that some solutions choose to rely on custom logs. Their tables will appear in the dedicated “Custom Logs” category as well, and not under the solution’s named category.

This is simply an update to the schema layout, so it doesn't affect your saved queries and general query syntax.
